//: How this bot behaves. The file is watched: edits take effect without a restart.

Bot.//Username: Without the @. Leave empty and it is read from Telegram at startup.

Scope.//Mode: AllChats = every chat the bot is added to. Allowlist = only AllowedChatIds.

Exempt.//: Admins, the team, trusted members - never deleted, never warned.

Moderators.//ChatId: Chat that receives notifications. 0 = no notifications.

Replies.//UseAiWhenNoRuleMatches: Needs an OpenAI key; answers in the commenter's language.

Rules.Name: price
Rules.Reply: Narxlar haqida to'liq ma'lumotni shaxsiy xabarda yuboramiz.

WorkingHours.//: When the team is actually around. Off = the bot behaves the same at any hour.
WorkingHours.//To: Earlier than From means the shift crosses midnight, e.g. 22:00 -> 06:00.

Outside.//Moderate: Keep deleting rule-breaking comments at night. Usually true.
Outside.//Replies: Silent = say nothing | AutoReply = answer once with Message
Outside.Message: Hozir ish vaqtimiz emas. Dushanba-juma, 9:00-18:00 oralig'ida javob beramiz.

PerChat.//: Example: a quieter, stricter chat. Remove or edit freely.
